probe_mode.description: How should training sessions be detected?

probe.title: Exercise / Training Settings (Day & Time)
probe.description: When does the weekly training take place?

probe_calendar.title: Exercise / Training Settings (Calendar)
probe_calendar.description: Select a calendar entity and enter keywords (comma-separated). When a calendar event is active that contains one of the keywords, time will be tracked as training. Optionally, all remaining calendar events (without a keyword) can be tracked as 'other' time when you leave the station for them.

data.track_other_absence: Recognize all other calendar entries as "other" time
data.sonstiges_grace_hours: Grace period after appointment end (hours) – how long after the appointment ends a return still counts (0 = must still be active on return)
data.ignore_allday_events: Ignore all-day events (short events running during them are still detected)

probe_both_day_time.title: Training – Day & Time Settings
probe_both_day_time.description: First configure the fixed training times. Calendar settings follow in the next step.

probe_both_calendar.title: Training – Calendar Settings
probe_both_calendar.description: In addition to fixed times: calendar events with keywords also trigger training tracking. Optionally, all remaining calendar events (without a keyword) can be tracked as 'other' time when you leave the station for them.

einsatz.title: Deployment & Notifications
einsatz.description: Settings for deployment tracking and optional push notifications.

data_description.notify_events: Freely combinable; nothing selected = no push. For both immediate options (outside events, fire-station presence) the added time can be reset by long-pressing the notification. The end-of-day summary (23:59, from 5 min) is info only and cannot be reset.
